readings.Aries: Something in your body is signalling before your mind has caught up. Trust the signal. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Taurus: Your body knows something your mind is still processing. Listen to it today. The first instinct was right.
readings.Gemini: Your flexibility is a gift to others and sometimes a burden to yourself. Draw a line. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Cancer: The person asking too much of you knows they're asking too much. That doesn't mean they'll stop without a signal. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Leo: Rest is not a failure of productivity. For you specifically, this requires repeating. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Virgo: Your eye for what's wrong is excellent. Your eye for what's right — exercise it today. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Libra: Your instinct for what looks and feels right is calibrated finely. Trust it on the bigger questions too. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: Something is ending that you don't want to end. Your resistance is understandable and will not stop it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Sagittarius: Your range is extraordinary. Today something narrow requires your full attention. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Capricorn: The authority you carry was earned. Use it with care today. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Aquarius: Your independence is real and it is also sometimes used to avoid being vulnerable. Notice that today. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: What you're calling chaos is actually pattern — you can see it if you look from further away. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
